_readme: Kiln manifest. Hand-edited on disk; the app reads it and shows it read-only at kilns.php. Blank fields are hidden in the UI, so fill in what you know next time you are in the kiln room. Any extra field you add to a kiln shows up automatically, with its name tidied up for the label.

studio.name: Waterloo Potter's Workshop
notes: Room intake and output fans run off the thermostat on the wall between kilns 2 and 3. The individual switch at each fan must be left on for the thermostat to control them.
Kiln fans are wired in pairs: kilns 1 and 2 exhaust together, kilns 3 and 4 exhaust together. Both kilns in a pair vent whether or not both are firing.
The panel box holds a numbered breaker switch for each kiln. Check yours is on before firing.
The floor must be dry to fire. If it has rained, check the red pail under the pipes to the right of the sink, empty it, and email the convener.
The sink has no clay trap. Nothing with clay, glaze or kiln wash in it goes down that drain.
Central vacuum outlet is just outside the furnace room. Vacuuming the kiln after every firing is mandatory.
Kiln convener and kiln maintenance contacts are posted on the bulletin board at the bottom of the stairs.
Bookings run 48 hours. Load no earlier than 6 pm the evening before your firing day; unload and clean up by 6 pm on the last day.

kilns.name: Kiln 1
kilns.power_switch: Push in the time sitter switch to power the elements — the red light comes on
kilns.element_settings: OFF, LO, 2, 4, 6, HI — up by 2 every hour
kilns.cones: Small kiln-sitter cone in the sitter (top shelf), plus witness cone packs at the peeps
quirks: The OFF position sits a little left of 12 o'clock. There is a pink dot of nail polish marking the right spot.
Set the sitter timer 30 minutes to 1 hour beyond the firing length you expect — it is a backstop, the sitter cone is what actually ends the firing.
The wall pyrometer is not very accurate, but it tells you the kiln is working.
You must stay at the workshop until the kiln is set to HI, then return for the last two hours.
kilns.notes: Also here as a teaching kiln, for members thinking about buying a used kiln for home.

kilns.name: Kiln 2
kilns.blurb: Power switch is on the wall. Shelves sag — flip them for bisque.
kilns.controller: Bartlett V6-CF Series 700, badged Euclid Kilns
kilns.power_switch: On the wall, not on the kiln
quirks: These shelves are the worst for sagging. Flip them for bisque firings to help straighten them out.
